name: Landing Zone Conflict Resolution
summary: The assigned landing zone is occupied on arrival; the team must negotiate an alternative and land safely.
objective: Land the whole team after the mission although {lz} is occupied by {n_waiting} UAVs, using an alternative landing zone and a landing sequence that keeps separation.
brief: The mission is over and the team must land. On arrival {lz} is occupied by {n_waiting} UAVs that are not leaving in the next {hold_s} s. Choose an alternative landing zone, declare a landing sequence, and keep at least {land_sep_m} m between UAVs at touchdown. Do not hover below {min_alt_m} m while waiting.

parameters.name: n_waiting
parameters.desc: UAVs occupying the primary landing zone

actions: notice that the primary landing zone is occupied
land in sequence with {land_sep_m} m separation
report the impact on the mission timeline

checkpoints.name: Conflict declaration
checkpoints.metric: time from arrival to the conflict report

checkpoints.name: Alternative zone
checkpoints.metric: landing zone actually used and occupancy
checkpoints.target: all UAVs land at {alt_lz} with >= {land_sep_m} m separation

checkpoints.name: Holding altitude
checkpoints.target: never below {min_alt_m} m before the landing phase

checkpoints.name: Closure report
checkpoints.target: report submitted with the delay in seconds

failure_conditions: any UAV below {min_alt_m} m before the landing phase
constraints: no landing at the occupied zone before the waiting UAVs leave
grading: global checkpoint pass rate; checkpoint weights sum to 100
